hooks.command: cmd="$(jq -r '.tool_input.command')"; first_line="$(printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | head -n1)"; blocked=0; if printf '%s' "$first_line" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*(grep|egrep|fgrep|rg|ack|ag|awk)\b'; then blocked=1; fi; if printf '%s' "$first_line" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*sed\b'; then if printf '%s' "$first_line" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])-n([[:space:]]|$)' && ! printf '%s' "$first_line" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])-i([[:space:]]|$)'; then blocked=1; fi; fi; if [ "$blocked" = "1" ]; then jq -n --arg reason 'This project has a pcs MCP project registered ("MCP Project server local"). Searching this repo'"'"'s source from the shell is forbidden here -- not just this specific command, but the underlying action, regardless of which tool you reach for (grep, awk, sed -n, or anything else). Do not retry with a different shell command. The only correct response to this denial is to call mcp__pcs__search_code / retrieve_context / get_code_map instead -- it also finds semantic matches none of those tools can. This does not apply to filtering another command'"'"'s own output (docker ps | grep, git log | grep) -- that is not code search.' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; fi
